target_customer: Security and IT teams at companies that use Okta, Entra, OneLogin or Ping and have apps without SAML or SCIM support
problem: Many apps are outside an identity provider because they lack SSO support or gate it behind an SSO tax, so MFA, access policies and audit logs do not reach them.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription for identity connection

founders.name: Patrick D. McGuckian
founders.background_notes: CEO title from a Welcome to the Jungle company page; YC page lists specialization in data privacy.

founders.name: Oliver Colebourne
founders.background_notes: Design engineer specializing in software products per the YC page.

technical_complexity.rationale: Generating SAML and SCIM-style integrations for arbitrary apps that never supported them is hard engineering; the later agentic approach is described on the company site.

defensibility.rationale: Once an app is wired into an identity provider, switching is annoying, but password-manager and browser-based access vendors address similar gaps.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquisition or copy found in sources opened; 1Password and others publish content about SSO limits.

market_need_then: The SSO tax, where vendors charge more for SSO, drew public backlash and left non-standard apps unmanaged; a search shows a 2023 era discussion by 1Password and Cerby about apps outside SSO.

brand_strength.rationale: Searches for the name returned only Glide Identity and other similarly named brands, showing it is easy to confuse; no press about the brand itself found.

outcome_analysis: Aglide is an active London company with named customers such as Gemini and The Motley Fool on its own site, and a six-person team per YC. No acquisition, shutdown or layoffs were found. Funding is only seen on aggregators, so capital efficiency and stage cannot be assessed reliably.
notes: Funding unverified, from aggregators only: about $500K pre-seed in Aug 2023 with Y Combinator (VCBacked, Seedtable, Extruct); CB Insights shows $600K over two rounds including $0.1M seed on 2023-10-01 with Davidovs Venture Collective; a geo.sig.ai page claims $3M to $3.5M seed and looks machine generated. The YC page does not state which founder is CEO; CEO title comes from a jobs site. Some listings place HQ in San Francisco; YC lists London. Competitors list empty since no sources dated 2023 naming direct competitors were found (1password and Cerby posts were undated or later). Rounds added: 500K pre-seed with YC (2023-08, VCBacked only) and a 0.1M seed on 2023-10-01 (CB Insights only); each rests on a single database and CB Insights totals 600K, so they may overlap.
